text:
Maya: Quick idea — let's trim the 'performance parity' line in the new battlecard. It's too vague vs cloud providers.
Leo: Totally. Suggest swapping to "predictable per-token economics" + a short point about graceful fallbacks. Also propose a one-line benchmark claim we can defend.
Sami: Love that. Can we make the SDR-facing card very scannable — 3 bullets, 1 quick objection handler each. Maybe a tiny ASCII table for latency tiers.
Frank: SDR ask: three soundbites for objection handling — cost, SLA (uptime + latency), and deployment flexibility. One-liners only.
Elaine: I drafted copy that calls out "dedicated GPU pools" and "private VPC option". Do we want to name-drop "single-tenant" or keep it implicit?
Maya: Keep it implicit. Use "customer-managed VPC" and "audit logs" instead of legal-y phrasing.
Ben: Here's a micro-snippet I put together:
```
- Hook: Predictable inference economics, not surprise bills
- Why it matters: Route-by-policy and autoscale keep latency SLOs and costs stable
- Rebut: If they say 'cloud X has cheaper GPUs' -> highlight batching + KV cache unit economics
```
Leo: Nice. For the upcoming webinar invite we're A/B testing headlines: A) "Predictable Inference Economics" vs B) "Serving LLMs at Product Scale". Thoughts?
Sami: I'll add to the experiment sheet. Also need a benchmark slide: p50/p95 vs public-hosted endpoints — we have internal perf snapshots, right?
Frank: Ops can share anonymized numbers. @ops-bot can you drop a recent perf snapshot (p50/p95, tokens/sec, quantized model profile)?
ops-bot: Export done. Snapshot: p50=42ms, p95=118ms, tokens/sec=2.1k (2048 context, quantized 4-bit). Attached CSV: /exports/perf_2024-06-08.csv
Maya: Perfect. I'll fold those stats into a visual and push a PR to the messaging repo, pinging Sales for a 30-min quick review. :rocket:
Ben: I'll prepare the SDR one-pager with three quick objections + suggested close lines.
Elaine: Once PR is up, I'll route to legal for a quick check on comparative language.
Maya: Goal: v0 live by EOD. Anyone object? If not, I'll merge and tag the webinar collateral.
Leo: No objections. +1
Sami: +1
Frank: +1
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled export every 24h at 02:00 UTC.
Maya: Thanks all — merging now. Will post link when live.
